build_birch_clustering: build a BIRCH clustering model on input data using threshold and branching_factor parameters to construct a CF Tree
create_birch_partial_fit: create incremental BIRCH clustering by calling partial_fit on successive data batches for online learning
test_birch_predict: test the Birch.predict method to assign cluster labels to new samples based on subcluster centroids
refactor_birch_transform: refactor the Birch.transform method to compute Euclidean distances from samples to subcluster centroids
review_birch_global_clustering: review the Birch._global_clustering method that clusters subcluster centroids using AgglomerativeClustering
